limitations: The Earth geography is new; all Moon/Mars query sites and model design were previously seen during development.

NASA regional analog context is not a positive label for any exact Earth window; random controls are not verified negative analogs.
Pilot Valley salts and underground Lava Beds caves cannot be inferred from a surface DEM; 20 m Mars grids cannot resolve 200 m fine structure at Moon quality.
No independent ratings existed when this protocol was frozen, and no material or mission equivalence score is available.
